programmes.d: Croxteth Hall stands as one of the Most Haunted places in the UK and tonight Karl enters the deserted upper floors alone to see what lurks in the shadows.
The small cottage on the grounds of Eden Camp has a reputation of being incredibly haunted. This time Stuart enters alone to see what awaits him.
Karl walks the deserted buildings at the incredibly haunted Eden Camp to investigate the paranormal activity witnessed by countless unsuspecting people.
Gregg enters the formidable Dorchester Prison for the first time, filled with apprehension and fear, he soon asks himself if this is a good idea.
Part 2 sees Gregg venture ever deeper into the depths of Dorchester Prison and finds himself lost.
Karl enters the very haunted cottage at Eden Camp alone, and it doesn’t disappoint.
The buildings that once housed POW’s from WWII are now inhabited by many a ghostly apparition, Stuart enters the chapel in search of whatever haunts there.
HMP Shrewsbury is one of Britain’s Most Haunted prisons. Karl takes on C-Wing and the execution chamber in search of the spirits that lurk in the shadows of this formidable place.
Yvette and Mary investigate the abandoned top floor of the very haunted Croxteth Hall, and all hell breaks loose as something seems to be determined to stop the investigation.
Part 2 sees Karl investigated the first floor of this amazing location and it soon becomes clear that something is there with him.
Lost footage from Most Haunted’s shoot at Lancaster Grand Theatre resurfaces. In Part 1, a team member investigates the haunted dressing rooms alone—with eerie results.
This episode features the following cases: The Land, Titan, The Diary, Town of Remembrance, The House on Barry Avenue.
This episode features the following cases: One for the Road, The Music Box, Two to One, Damsel, The Horn.
This episode features the following cases: Dead Beat Daddy, Ghost Town, The Sewing Machine, The Sleepwalker, Money Laundry.
This episode features the following cases: The Mystery of Douglas Hibbard, Wheelchair Man, The Vigil, The Mandarin's Bowl, Ghost Writer.

As a young girl Kimberly constantly played with her sister Sarah whom no one else could see. Her mother became concerned when Kimberly said that sister pushed her into a fire.
Four year-old Andrew talked to people no one else could see, and told his mother he was killed by a bomb.
Anissa's mom thought it was cute when her daughter told her stories about living in a place called New York.
From the time he was little, Seumas had an obsession with large ships, and extreme anxiety about his own death.
Aiden's mother becomes concerned when he tells her about a sister he doesn't have and a house he has never lived in.
As a young boy Brayden begins telling his family details of his Great Uncle's Murder.
Regis Philbin spends a terrifying night in a notorious haunted house trying to coax its ghosts into sight; Harry Hamlin's wedding proposal is foiled by a ghost with a broken heart.
Faced with a decision that would change his life, Bret Michaels is visited by a close relative who points him toward his destiny.

This time Yvette and her team ventures into the dark abyss of the cellars under this large country house. Without exception every member of the team experience something unexplained as the darkness starts to come to life.

Yvette heads to Tamworth and a beautiful manor house that is said to be filled with paranormal occurrences. Almost as soon as the team get there something seems to want to make itself known with dramatic effect.
The team continue their investigation into the Moat House and some regret that decision as objects fly and a little girls doll seems to tell a tale.
Karl enters a Masonic Temple alone, seeking the truth behind its eerie reputation. The mysterious world of Freemasonry soon reveals a chilling presence in the shadows.
Cameras are left locked-off in haunted sites across the country, capturing chilling activity in a bold experiment with some truly remarkable results.
Karl enters the formidable HMP Gloucester and sets up an experiment with some amazing results.
Karl and Stuart explore Birmingham's Coffin Works, a hotspot of eerie activity. On the top floor, where burial shrouds were made, something unseen seems keen on making tea.
With Karl on the top floor, Stuart investigates the first floor of this very haunted building and something in the office seems to want to make itself known.
The attic space of Hodroyd Hall is one of the properties most haunted areas and Karl & Stuart venture into the darkness to find out what haunts this atmospheric place.
Yvette and Karl return to the very haunted Delapre Abbey, where Karl’s attempts to put Yvette in a room on her own, Yvette finds a lift and an unseen force makes itself known.
